verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the whole issue-to-PR loop: Claude Code integrates with GitHub and GitLab to read issues, write code, run tests and submit PRs (docs-16). The MCP docs give the explicit example "Add the feature described in JIRA issue ENG-4521 and create a PR on GitHub" (docs-30), and other docs cover branch creation and opening PRs (docs-3), Slack bug report to PR (docs-11), and @claude tagging on GitHub (gh-1). Community reports that its self-verification cannot be trusted (comm-16) and of high failure rates (comm-19) lower confidence in how complete the resulting PRs are, but they do not specifically contradict the documented workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a successful issue-to-merged-PR run, and detailed docs on the GitHub issue trigger flow beyond overview-level claims.
